text:
Sophie R: Heads up — seeing a 3-5x tail increase in token emit latency for `short-chat` routes after last night's deploy. Correlates with continuous-batcher tweaks. :eyes:

Diego L: Ugh. Which metric exactly? p95/p99 or per-token tail?

Sophie R: Token-level breakdown (last 10m):
```
batch_size_hist: {1:62%, 2:20%, 3-8:14%, >8:4%}
queue_wait_ms: p50=12, p95=240, p99=680
per_token_emit_ms: p50=3.2, p95=42, p99=210
kernel_switch_rate: 0.8/s -> 3.5/s (spike since 02:12 UTC)
kv_cache_hit_ratio: 78% -> 55% (same window)
```

Jamal: That kv cache drop + kernel_switch spike smells like frequent kernel handoffs invalidating caches. Could be continuous-batcher generating many small prefixes that force different kernel codepaths. :thinking:

Maya: Can you link the runbook query? I want to overlay per-route p95 and kernel selection tags.

Sophie R: grafana: /d/redwood/runtime?orgId=1&from=-15m&to=now&var-route=short-chat — added the screenshot in thread (see thread attachment).

Oliver: Ran a quick micro-replay against the 02:00->02:20 window with --sample=0.1. Raw sampler output: 
```
replay: requests=4300, avg_batch=1.7, batches=2529
avg_queue_wait=18ms, long_wait_count(>300ms)=37
kernel_path_counts: fast-attn=2100, fallback=2200
kvcache_inserts=6100, evictions=5900
```

Diego L: Nice. Evictions nearly equal inserts — kv thrash. If kernel_path flips between implementations we could be flushing CPU/GPU caches. Can we force single kernel for a minute to test?

Jamal: Yes. Try setting kernel_selector.prefer_single=true on the runtime for +5m and observe p99. Also bump batcher.min_window_ms=8 to avoid too many micro-batches.

ci-bot: Rollout notice: deploy 9f3a2b4 (continuous-batcher v2) finished at 2026-11-08T02:05:12Z. Triggered canary -> full.

Sophie R: I'm going to flip prefer_single on canary (10% traffic) and raise min_window. Will post numbers in 5m. :thumbsup:

Maya: I exported a quick dashboard panel query to Console -> TempViews -> "island-sampler-probe". Link: /console/tempviews/1234

(5m later)

Sophie R: Canary numbers after tweak:
```
queue_wait_ms: p95=68, p99=110
per_token_emit_ms: p95=8.9, p99=28
batch_size_hist: {1:45%, 2:32%, 3-8:18%, >8:5%}
kvcache_hit_ratio: 76%
```

Diego L: That's promising — tail collapsed on canary. Suggest rolling the config change cluster-wide but with staged ramp (25/50/100) and watch evictions.

Oliver: Filed a short PR to add an automatic safety guard: if kernel_switch_rate > 1.5/s and kv_eviction_rate > X, temporarily bias kernel_selector to single-path and increase batcher.min_window_ms. PR: github.com/redwood/runtime/pulls/4123

Jamal: Add a test to ensure continuous-batcher doesn't produce lots of tiny prefixes for short prompts. Could be tuning the prefix coalescer.

Sophie R: Agreed. Action items:
- Roll config change (prefer_single + min_window_ms=8) staged 25/50/100 (Diego)
- Add prefix coalescer regression test and metric (Jamal)
- Add temporary dashboard alert for kernel_switch_rate + kv_eviction spike (Maya)
- Follow up on PR and keep canary pinned until next green (Oliver)

Diego L: I'm taking the rollout now. Will post timeline.

Maya: I'll add the dashboard alert (5m).

Sophie R: Thanks all. Will monitor and update thread if anything else pops. :raised_hands:
